title: Org Security Control Panel: IP allowlist, sharing & export restrictions
creator: Evan Chen
description: Add a new Org Security Control Panel in the Redwood Console that centralizes enforcement toggles for regulated customers. Scope includes: 1) IP allowlist (org-level + optional team override), 2) Disable public sharing (prevent creation of public share links and limit cross-org links), 3) Data export restrictions (block CSV/JSON/embeddings bulk export and third-party connector exports). The control panel must: integrate with RBAC v2 roles so only org-admins can change settings; emit structured audit logs for every toggle change and attempted policy violation; support enforcement both at the application/API gateway layer and at downstream model serving (for Private/Dedicated), and provide a migration path for orgs with existing custom policies.
acceptance_criteria: UI: New console page under Settings > Security with three toggles and per-toggle explanation text
RBAC: Only users with org-admin role (RBAC v2) can view/change toggles
Enforcement: IP allowlist is enforced at API gateway for hosted, with clear 403 responses and documented error codes
Export controls: attempts to export when disabled must be blocked and recorded in audit logs
Audit: Every change emits structured audit event (actor, before, after, reason, IP, request_id) available in audit-log stream
E2E tests: automated integration tests for UI, API, and audit events included in PR
Migration: existing org-level settings preserved and surfaced for manual review before rollout
tasks: Design console UI and copy (design ticket: DES-2041)
Backend API: PATCH /orgs/:id/security-controls with schema validation and policy versioning
Gateway enforcement: add allowlist middleware with fast path cache and metrics
Audit hooks: extend audit pipeline to include policy change events and blocked action events
RBAC integration: gate pages and APIs via RBAC v2 role checks
Migration job: one-time job to annotate existing orgs and surface exceptions
Docs: update operator guide, API reference, and public changelog
